name: gina-lib-swig-trusted-loader
description: Per-bundle opt-out to swig-core's filesystem-loader basepath confinement (CVE-2023-25345). Builds the synchronous swig fs loader with a trustedRoots allowlist: nested include / import may resolve into declared out-of-root directories while everything else stays confined. Confined-by-default (empty/absent trustedRoots returns the stock swig.loaders.fs(dir)); fail-closed (never sets swig-core's blanket allowOutsideRoot). Consumed by initSwigEngine (server.js) and the per-request swig setup (controller.js).
